description: This file defines a front-end component called 'NotesList' using the LightningJS framework. It manages displaying a list of notes, search functionality, and user interactions such as selecting, creating, and navigating notes. It interacts with an external NoteService to fetch, search, and create notes.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A LightningJS component for displaying and interacting with a list of notes, including searching, selection, and creation.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches all notes from NoteService and updates the view.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters notes based on the search query and updates focus and selection accordingly.

methods.name: ensureOnSelect
methods.description: Ensures the current selected note is properly notified via the onSelect callback.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and applies filtering.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new note via NoteService, refreshes the list, and triggers selection.

methods.name: focusNext
methods.description: Moves focus down the list of notes.

methods.name: focusPrev
methods.description: Moves focus up the list of notes.

methods.name: $rowColor
methods.description: Determines background color of a row based on whether it is selected.

methods.name: $rowAlpha
methods.description: Determines alpha transparency of a row based on selection.

methods.name: $time
methods.description: Formats an ISO date string into a human-readable 'Edited' timestamp.
